annotations.title: Reconcile B2B Wholesale Net-15/30/60 Deposits & Credit Notes

description: Reconcile B2B wholesale Net-15, Net-30, and Net-60 invoice deposits, partial payments, and credit notes using exact integer minor-unit (EUR/USD cent) arithmetic with zero IEEE-754 floating-point drift. Executes as a pure, stateless, read-only financial reconciliation function. Returns structuredContent containing ok, mode, statelessEphemeralAudit, tenantId, and reconciliation (state, status, fulfillmentHold, releaseHoldAction, requiredDepositCents, remainingBalanceCents, creditDueCents, overpaidWarning, orderTag). Use this tool for B2B wholesale order deposit gating and Net-terms balance calculation; use revclamp_validate_eu_vat_vies for cross-border EU VAT number validation.

creditNoteCents.description: Optional post-invoice credit notes or return adjustments in integer cents (valid range: 0 to totalOrderCents, default: 0; singular alias for creditNotesCents).

creditNotesCents.description: Optional post-invoice credit notes or return adjustments in integer cents (valid range: 0 to totalOrderCents, default: 0; plural alias for creditNoteCents).

daysElapsedSinceInvoice.description: Optional elapsed integer days since invoice issuance (valid range: 0 to 3650, default: 5).

orderId.description: B2B wholesale order or invoice identifier (e.g. 'gid://shopify/Order/908812' or 'ORD-2026-9088', default: 'ord_local_b2b_01', max 64 chars).

orderTotalCents.description: Alias for totalOrderCents: gross invoice total in positive integer minor currency units / cents (must be > 0).

paidAmountCents.description: Required cumulative amount collected from the buyer in non-negative integer cents (e.g. 75000 for 750.00 EUR; must be >= 0).

paymentTermsDays.description: Optional B2B net payment terms maturity window in integer days (allowed values: 15, 30, or 60 for Net-15, Net-30, or Net-60; default: 30).

requiredDepositCents.description: Optional explicit upfront deposit threshold in integer cents (valid range: 0 to effectiveTotalCents). Overrides requiredDepositPercent when provided.

requiredDepositPercent.description: Optional upfront deposit percentage required before releasing warehouse fulfillment hold (valid range: 0 to 100, default: 30 i.e. 30% upfront deposit).

toleranceCents.description: Optional rounding/FX reconciliation tolerance in integer cents (valid range: 0 to min(500, 1% of totalOrderCents), default: 0).

totalOrderCents.description: Gross invoice total in positive integer minor currency units / cents (e.g. 250000 for 2,500.00 EUR; must be > 0).
